```{r}
load_wine_tsibble <- function(path = "AustralianWines.csv") {
  raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  raw %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Month,
      names_to = "Varietal",
      values_to = "Sales_raw"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Month = yearmonth(my(Month)),
      Sales = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Sales_raw))
    ) %>%
    select(Month, Varietal, Sales) %>%
    as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal)
}
```

```{r}
load_wine_tsibble <- function(path = "AustralianWines.csv") {
  raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  raw %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Month,
      names_to = "Varietal",
      values_to = "Sales_raw",
      values_transform = list(Sales_raw = as.character)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Month = yearmonth(my(Month)),
      Sales = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Sales_raw))
    ) %>%
    select(Month, Varietal, Sales) %>%
    as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal)
}
```

```{r}

wine_ts <- load_wine_tsibble("AustralianWines.csv")
all_varietals <- unique(wine_ts$Varietal)
min_ym <- min(wine_ts$Month)
max_ym <- max(wine_ts$Month)

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Australian Wine Sales: Model Comparison & Forecasting",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 310,
    selectizeInput(
      inputId = "varietals",
      label = "Select Varietal(s)",
      choices = all_varietals,
      selected = c("sparkling", "Dry white"),
      multiple = TRUE,
      options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))
    ),
    sliderInput(
      inputId = "date_range",
      label = "Data Date Range",
      min = as.Date(min_ym),
      max = as.Date(max_ym),
      value = c(as.Date(min_ym), as.Date(max_ym)),
      timeFormat = "%b %Y"
    ),
    sliderInput(
      inputId = "train_end",
      label = "Training Window End (Validation Starts After)",
      min = as.Date(min_ym) %m+% months(24),
      max = as.Date(max_ym) %m-% months(6),
      value = as.Date("1992-12-01"),
      timeFormat = "%b %Y"
    ),
    numericInput(
      inputId = "horizon",
      label = "Future Forecast Horizon (Months)",
      value = 18,
      min = 1,
      max = 48,
      step = 1
    ),
    checkboxGroupInput(
      inputId = "models_selected",
      label = "Models to Fit & Compare",
      choices = c("TSLM", "ETS", "ARIMA"),
      selected = c("TSLM", "ETS", "ARIMA")
    ),
    checkboxInput(
      inputId = "show_intervals",
      label = "Show Prediction Intervals (80% / 95%)",
      value = TRUE
    ),
    helpText("Tip: Select 2+ varietals to compare faceted trends and model accuracy side by side.")
  ),

  navset_card_tab(
    nav_panel(
      title = "Overview & Decomposition",
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = 12,
        card(
          card_header(
            class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
            "Historical Monthly Sales",
            checkboxInput(
              inputId = "show_stl",
              label = "Show STL Decomposition (Trend & Seasonality)",
              value = FALSE
            )
          ),
          plotOutput("overview_plot", height = "460px")
        )
      )
    ),

    nav_panel(
      title = "Forecasts & Evaluation",
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = 12,
        card(
          card_header("Comparative Forecasts & Validation Overlay"),
          plotOutput("forecast_plot", height = "460px")
        )
      ),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = 12,
        card(
          card_header("Model Specifications (Auto-Selected)"),
          tableOutput("spec_table")
        )
      ),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = 6,
        card(
          card_header("Training Window Accuracy"),
          tableOutput("train_metrics_table")
        ),
        card(
          card_header("Validation Window Accuracy"),
          tableOutput("val_metrics_table")
        )
      )
    ),

    nav_panel(
      title = "About & Reproducibility",
      card(
        card_header("Dataset, Modeling & Reproducibility Notes"),
        markdown("
- **Data Source:** `AustralianWines.csv` (180 monthly observations from Jan 1980 to Dec 1994 across 6 varietals; non-numeric `*` entries in `Rose` are parsed as missing `NA`).
- **Models:** `TSLM(Sales ~ trend() + season())`, automatic `ETS(Sales)`, and automatic `ARIMA(Sales)` fit strictly on the training slice (`Month <= train_end`).
- **Evaluation:** Validation metrics are scored on held-out observations (`train_end < Month <= end of selected date range`), while future forecasts project `h` months beyond the selected window.
- **Reproducing Figures:** Set the sidebar inputs (**Select Varietal(s)**, **Data Date Range**, **Training Window End**, **Future Forecast Horizon**, and **Models to Fit & Compare**) to match your story caption.
        ")
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Validate inputs and filter tsibble
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    validate(
      need(length(input$varietals) >= 1, "Please select at least one varietal."),
      need(length(input$models_selected) >= 1, "Please select at least one model.")
    )

    start_ym <- yearmonth(input$date_range[1])
    end_ym <- yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
    train_ym <- yearmonth(input$train_end)

    validate(
      need(start_ym < train_ym, "Start date must be earlier than Training Window End."),
      need(train_ym < end_ym, "Training Window End must be earlier than Data End date so a validation window exists.")
    )

    wine_ts %>%
      filter(Varietal %in% input$varietals, Month >= start_ym, Month <= end_ym)
  })

  train_data <- reactive({
    train_ym <- yearmonth(input$train_end)
    filtered_data() %>%
      filter_index(. ~ format(train_ym, "%Y %b"))
  })

  val_data <- reactive({
    train_ym <- yearmonth(input$train_end)
    next_ym <- train_ym + 1
    filtered_data() %>%
      filter_index(format(next_ym, "%Y %b") ~ .)
  })

  # Fit models per varietal on training window only
  fitted_models <- reactive({
    tr <- train_data()
    sel <- input$models_selected
    validate(need(length(sel) >= 1, "Please select at least one model."))

    m_all <- model(
      tr,
      TSLM  = TSLM(Sales ~ trend() + season()),
      ETS   = ETS(Sales),
      ARIMA = ARIMA(Sales)
    )

    select(m_all, Varietal, all_of(sel))
  })

  # Validation forecasts (for out-of-sample scoring) and future forecasts
  val_forecasts <- reactive({
    vd <- val_data()
    validate(need(nrow(vd) > 0, "Validation window has no rows."))
    forecast(fitted_models(), new_data = vd)
  })

  future_forecasts <- reactive({
    validate(need(is.numeric(input$horizon) && input$horizon >= 1, "Horizon must be >= 1."))
    forecast(fitted_models(), h = input$horizon)
  })

  # Overview plot (time series or STL decomposition)
  output$overview_plot <- renderPlot({
    dat <- filtered_data()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_stl)) {
      stl_dat <- dat %>%
        group_by_key() %>%
        mutate(Sales_interp = zoo::na.approx(Sales, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
        ungroup()

      dcmp <- stl_dat %>%
        model(STL(Sales_interp ~ season(window = "periodic"), robust = TRUE)) %>%
        components()

      autoplot(dcmp) +
        labs(
          title = "STL Decomposition of Selected Varietals",
          x = "Month"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    } else {
      autoplot(dat, Sales) +
        facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
        labs(
          title = "Monthly Wine Sales by Varietal",
          subtitle = paste0(
            "Selected window: ",
            format(yearmonth(input$date_range[1]), "%b %Y"),
            " to ",
            format(yearmonth(input$date_range[2]), "%b %Y")
          ),
          x = "Month",
          y = "Sales"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    }
  })

  # Comparative forecast plot with actuals overlaid and optional intervals
  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    actuals <- filtered_data()
    fc <- future_forecasts()

    autoplot(fc, actuals, level = if (isTRUE(input$show_intervals)) c(80, 95) else NULL, alpha = 0.75) +
      facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
      labs(
        title = "Model Forecast Comparison with Actuals",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Trained through ", format(yearmonth(input$train_end), "%b %Y"),
          " | Forecast horizon: ", input$horizon, " months"
        ),
        x = "Month",
        y = "Sales",
        colour = "Model",
        fill = "Prediction Interval"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  })

  # Human-readable model specification table
  output$spec_table <- renderTable({
    m <- fitted_models()
    m_long <- m %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Varietal, names_to = "Model", values_to = "Fit")

    tibble(
      Varietal = m_long$Varietal,
      Model = m_long$Model,
      `Model Specification` = vapply(m_long$Fit, fabletools::model_sum, character(1))
    ) %>%
      arrange(Varietal, Model)
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  # Training accuracy table
  output$train_metrics_table <- renderTable({
    fabletools::accuracy(fitted_models()) %>%
      select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) %>%
      rename(Model = .model) %>%
      mutate(across(c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE), ~ round(.x, 2)))
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  # Validation accuracy table
  output$val_metrics_table <- renderTable({
    fabletools::accuracy(val_forecasts(), val_data()) %>%
      select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) %>%
      rename(Model = .model) %>%
      mutate(across(c(RMSE, MAE, MAPE), ~ round(.x, 2)))
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
